decision_cruda.rationale: Radio and CMMS agree on both failures. E569-10 has 259 t at 5.8 g/t, and LH-06 is back around 11:30 (range 11:00 to 12:00). Even at its likely return it can't clear the stope by 17:00 (about 211 t). LH-08 is the cheaper heading loader (1.0 oz/h) and is 0.73 h away. It would load about 41 t (7.7 oz) before LH-06 returns, at a cost of about 2.2 oz. Este has room in its stockpile (162/450 t), so the trucks aren't a limit. C564-14 (134 t at 12.1 g/t): LH-01's likely return at 13:30 still leaves about 143 t of loading time before 17:00, enough to clear it. A loan from LH-09 would cost about 1.5 oz/h for 3.7 h or more, so I'm not covering it. If the repair runs to the high estimate it would be worth revisiting.
